message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s public‑safety authorities.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to Do | Contact |
|------|------------|---------|
| 1 | Identify the area of the complaint (e.g., which neighborhood or street). | – |
| 2 | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000** (or dial 311 from within the city). | 404‑656‑4000 |
| 3 | If you prefer online, submit a form via the City of Atlanta’s official website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> under “Noise Complaint.” | – |
| 4 | Provide details: date/time, location, description of the noise, and any evidence (audio recordings, photos). | – |
| 5 | You’ll receive a reference number; keep it for follow‑up. | – |

If the issue involves a business or commercial property, you may also contact the Atlanta Office of Business Licensing at **404‑656‑4000** or visit <https://www.atlantaga.gov/business>.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more specific guidance on filing the complaint or following up!
